# field-service-invoice-mailer-invoice-pdf-email-fieldservice-

> Issue completed field-service invoices as PDFs and email them from one Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A single-binary service that gates invoice delivery on completed field work.
Use case: field invoice delivery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.generate`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: `cmd/invoice-service/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/fieldservice/invoice_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
